title: Concept: Key Vault secret URI in a response
description: A Key Vault secret URI naming the vault and secret in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URI names the vault and the exact secret version, so a principal with any read grant on the vault has the precise path to the credential the App uses.
applicability: Deployments that render a Key Vault secret URI naming the vault and secret into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URI names the vault and the exact secret version, so a principal with any read grant on the vault has the precise path to the credential the App uses.
